thread:
nina: Drafting a compact sidecar for first-run that groups the checklist, a small sample gallery, and the quickstart CTA. Goal: keep the main canvas visible while guiding new users. Feedback? :wave:

omar: Love non-blocking guidance. One ask: keep the sidecar from stealing initial focus. Let users tab into it, don't trap them unless they click 'Guide me'.

tess: For the sample gallery, micro-previews + one-line benefit copy. Eg 'FinOps dashboard — monitor cost trends'. Make thumbnails lightweight SVGs, defer big images.

mike: Copy tweak: change generic CTA 'Get started' to 'Create demo workspace' or 'Try sample app' depending on context. Specific CTAs convert better.

a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist: keyboard focus order, visible focus ring (4px min), aria-live for step updates, reduced motion support, and 4.5:1 text contrast.

nina: UX idea: collapsed state shows three compact chips "Checklist (3) | Samples (4) | Keys". On first visit, auto-expand for 6s with a subtle pulse; record telemetry only after consent.

omar: Perf note: only prefetch sample metadata and thumbnails. Import should use optimistic UI + background queue and show inline retry on failure.

tess: Microcopy: header 'Quick setup (5 mins)' — low time commitment helps. For import modal, use 'Create demo workspace \u2014 sandbox, free to delete' as helper text.

mike: QA metrics: sample click-through, import completion, time-to-first-API-call. Also track import error rate to prioritize infra fixes.

a11y-bot: For screen readers, add aria-label on the sidecar toggle and aria-describedby for preview buttons clarifying billing won't be charged.

nina: Great. I'll mock two variants and put them behind flags (pulse vs no-pulse). @tess please add the microcopy; @omar can you handle background queue retries; @mike set up the metrics. I'll post mocks this afternoon. :rocket:
